📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

🌿 Brayden checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🛟 Tom stands up by the fire. "We take the hit and we answer it — standing here isn't an answer. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."

🔥 The fire settles. Hank has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sami says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Luis breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Brayden has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Wei says quietly "We've been walking past those." Nikos says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dineo says quietly "And you're still standing." Wei asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
"We've been watching you figure things out all week! This one's on us — a head start! But the REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
